method: Rare, endangered and historically eroded indigenous-cultivar research. Official National Wine Agency descriptions establish historical/viticultural context; names in the research queue are identities requiring further VIVC/national synonym and genetic normalization before generation. Historical scarcity does not by itself prove present commercial area.

profiles.name: Kisi

historicalStatus.summary: Official Georgian source describes Kisi as having become nearly extinct by around 2000 before renewed plantings.
drivers: vineyard decline after the collapse of the Soviet Union
historicalStatus.survivorEvidence: Official source notes surviving old vines, including 50–60 year-old vines in the Telavi area, alongside renewed planting.

researchNotes: Do not infer that all Kisi is the Magraani local form; the PDO specification's historical description of Magraani material is not treated as genetic proof of a distinct variety.

profiles.name: Ojaleshi

historicalStatus.summary: Official Georgian source describes Ojaleshi as an old western Georgian variety historically grown in maghlari/tree-trained systems and heavily reduced by fungal diseases and phylloxera.

researchNotes: The 2004 area figure is a historical snapshot, not a current planted-area claim.

profiles.name: Jani

historicalStatus.summary: Official Georgian source describes Jani as a native Gurian variety that was formerly more widespread and is now rare.

viticulture.ripening: very late; official source describes November ripening
viticulture.diseaseContext: official variety description records disease sensitivities requiring exact field extraction before numerical resistance scoring

researchNotes: The exceptionally low published yield is retained as an official variety observation and must not be generalized to every site or vintage.

queuePolicy: A name in the queue means an official regional source attests historical/local relevance. It does not establish prime-variety identity, synonym equivalence, current commercial planting, product legality or sensory profile. Those require cultivar-level normalization and additional sources.
